scenarios.title: Invasion of Siberia
scenarios.map: Manchuria/Mongolia-to-Siberia northward offensive; Russian taiga, steppe, broad river corridors and genuine E.U. cities; viable approach from the south.
scenarios.design: Large Chinese Army Groups, mobility/supply pressure, rivers, realistic Siberian distances; do not treat the entire region as empty tundra.

scenarios.title: Invasion of the Caucasus
scenarios.map: Federation pushes north from Persia through Azerbaijan/Georgia and into E.U. southern Russia; Greater Caucasus passes, Caspian coast, Baku/Tbilisi/Vladikavkaz.
scenarios.design: Several traversable mountain axes, fortified E.U. positions, meaningful Caspian ports and inland industry, no geographically impossible mountain shortcut.

scenarios.title: Invasion of Turkey
scenarios.map: Federation attacks west from Persia/Caucasus into eastern Anatolia; Ankara and Istanbul objectives; Black Sea and Mediterranean geography.
scenarios.design: Eastern mountainous approach, Bosporus/strait crossing must actually work, naval options only where supported, defenders sufficiently entrenched.

scenarios.title: Battle for the Volga
scenarios.map: Chinese offensives from Caucasus and east/western Siberian staging into E.U. Volga region; Volgograd, Saratov, Kazan, riverbanks and bridges.
scenarios.design: Multiple playable crossings, significant industry, defender riverline, strong Chinese Army Group axes; avoid crossing-free stalemates.

scenarios.title: Crossing the Suez Canal
scenarios.map: Chinese expedition staging in Sinai east of Suez, E.U. holding western canal bank, Cairo, Nile Delta and Alexandria; include Mediterranean and Red Sea where useful.
scenarios.design: Make actual canal water and bridges/ferries playable; defensible but breachable west bank; expedition survives without captured cities when eligible; avoid fake land bridge.

scenarios.title: Battle for Moscow
scenarios.map: Federation advances from Volga into E.U. western Russian heartland around Moscow; defendable Moscow plus nearby real industrial cities and river systems.
scenarios.design: Decisive layered defense, balanced Chinese multi-axis offensive, appropriate production; do not include St Petersburg as a mandatory objective (user approved Moscow only).

scenarios.title: Balkan Offensive
scenarios.map: Federation drives northwest from Turkey through Bulgaria, Greece, Serbia and adjacent Balkan countries; authentic borders, rivers, mountains and Adriatic/Aegean coasts.
scenarios.design: Passable Thrace/Bosporus approaches; proper sea/coast, Balkans defenses with several advancing axes and port positions.

scenarios.title: North African Offensive
scenarios.map: Chinese advances west from Egypt across Libya, Tunisia and Algeria; Tripoli, Benghazi, Tunis, Algiers, proper coast and Sahara geography.
scenarios.design: Med naval presence, ports capture, usable coastal invasion corridor, no impassable desert gaps; secure staging bases for southern France.

scenarios.title: Conquest of Central Europe
scenarios.map: E.U. Poland, Czechia, Slovakia, Hungary and Austria; Federation attacks from conquered Russian/Balkan directions. Germany absolutely excluded from map and objectives.
scenarios.design: Industrial cities, rivers and mountains, dense defenses; do not drift west into Germany and do not use Germany as a staging/invasion corridor to France.

scenarios.title: Invasion of France
scenarios.map: Federation carriers/transports off southern France from captured North African Mediterranean bases; French coast Marseille/Toulon and advance via Lyon to Paris.
scenarios.design: France only; Federation starts with ships and embarked troops, ZERO French cities, no Germany land-entry front; E.U. holds all French cities initially. Genuine southern amphibious assault, France total conquest, cityless expedition rule.
